name: printpass-monorepo
description: PrintPass - Skip the queue. Print on time. MERN multi-tenant cloud print management for colleges.

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix agent install
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test && npm --prefix agent test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
